name: Shimon
source:
A girl who lives in the shadow village. She’s very carefree and not a quick thinker, perhaps because she grew up in such a peaceful village. Her tendency to speak in a way that misses the point sometimes irritates Meito. 

She introduces Meito to the world of shadows to aid him in his search for the mysterious voice.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=195]MangaGamer[/url]]
